New England Fiddler’s Repertoire tune index

A searchable, unofficial index of all 168 tunes in Randy Miller and Jack Perron’s New England Fiddler’s Repertoire (NEFR) — the jigs, reels, hornpipes and marches every musician playing for New England contra dances is expected to know. Sort by book order to browse it by number.

Sheet music and playback come from John Chambers’ collection of community transcriptions chosen to sit close to the NEFR versions; 155 tunes also link to thesession.org.
